name: Skyclaves
description: Seven floating Kor structures built as strongholds above each continent, which fell over a century and rose again.

description_citations.text: "Zendikar (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ancient kor empire of Zendikar falls one by one to rebellions, civil wars and the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: One by one they fell to rebellions, civil wars, and eventually the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse the kor empire never fell and still controls Zendikar from the Skyclaves.
timeline.quote: the kor empire never fell, and they still hold significant control over the plane from the Skyclaves.

citation.text: "Kor", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kor Empire collapses and each Skyclave falls in a different way, from the Roil, rebellion, a sea beast, civil war, Kargan dragons, Iona, and an Eldrazi titan.
timeline.quote: over a century, the empire fractured and ultimately collapsed

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The fall of the Skyclaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kesenya's adventurers inadvertently trigger Emeria's defenses, awakening six more Skyclaves.
timeline.quote: the adventurers inadvertently triggered the Skyclave's dormant magical defenses

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Adventurers awaken the Emeria Skyclave and the other six, which rise back into the sky.
timeline.quote: all seven Skyclaves rose back into the air and opened

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The compleated Nahiri transforms the Emeria Skyclave into a Phyrexian engine and realigns the hedrons for Realmbreaker; Sea Gate falls again.
timeline.quote: As Phyrexians scurried into Zendikar, Sea Gate was defeated once more.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
